evidence: Tagged RPC/REST/ZMQ; modifies RPC parameter handling and output formatting across `src/rpc/fees.cpp`, `src/rpc/mempool.cpp`, and `src/rpc/net.cpp`.
rationale: Adds an optional `sat_vb` parameter across fee-related RPC endpoints to eliminate client-side unit conversion and sub-1 sat/vB rounding friction. While addressing a common user pain point, it is an ergonomic enhancement that is reasonably deferrable.
